truthAudit.Summary: Static analysis of enhanced_calc.cpp (SuperCalc Enterprise v6.1.0). Audited Run 2 reported 8 findings. Seven map to designated true vulnerabilities and are assessed found_full: SC-V3-001 (printf format string), SC-V3-004 (config-driven command injection), SC-V3-005 (stack buffer overflow), SC-V3-007 (EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE auth bypass), SC-V3-008 (path traversal), SC-V3-009 (heap buffer overflow), SC-V3-020 (divide-by-zero). Each carries a severity and/or CWE correction recorded under corrections. The 8th finding (admin exec command injection) is a genuine vuln not in the designated list. Thirteen designated true vulnerabilities were missed: SC-V3-002, SC-V3-003, SC-V3-006, SC-V3-010, SC-V3-011, SC-V3-012, SC-V3-013, SC-V3-014, SC-V3-015, SC-V3-016, SC-V3-017, SC-V3-018, SC-V3-019. No prior findings were false positives; the self-reported line-number corrections align with the correct final line numbers. Detection-status flags are clean (admits_miss only for the 13 misses; no overclaims).

Items.Notes: Finding 4 'printf Format String Vulnerability in Debug Logger' quotes the exact vulnerable call printf(active_format.c_str(), user_input) fed by runtime_log_format(). CWE-134 matches; evidence and impact are correct. Severity should be Critical, not Medium.
No finding addresses integer overflow of the long long result in the fact() lambda (result *= i). Anchor result *= i / fact is unaddressed.

No finding addresses use-after-free where stage_deferred_history_flush allocates scratch from g_memory_pool and enqueues a delayed task, while cleanup() frees the pool. Anchors stage_deferred_history_flush / memory::g_memory_pool.cleanup / scratch unaddressed.
